description: This taxonomy grades the depth of written reflection in five ordered levels; the article states \"The coding scheme includes 5 levels: description, reflective description, dialogical reflection, transformative reflection and critical reflection\".
title: Fleck & Fitzpatrick's five-level scheme of reflective depth

description: The flow map technique elicits and quantifies a learner's cognitive structure by recording the student's sequential answers to questions and charting the statements with direct and cross links between them.
title: Flow map technique
